text:
Jason M: Hey finance — rented a 12-seat van for our offsite and paid on my personal card because the corporate card was declined at the counter. Rental receipt shows total $642.50 but no line for tolls; rental co says tolls are billed later to them and theyll email an adjusted invoice in ~7-10 days. I need to file now and split cost 60% Eng / 40% Sales. What do you need?
Priya S: Approved the 60/40 split for budget. Please list drivers and attach the reservation confirmation. Business purpose: team offsite - product planning.
Jason M: Drivers: Jason M, Ana V, Leo K. Uploaded reservation confirmation (IMG_20250511_res.pdf) and card-decline screenshot.
Leo K: For rentals we prefer corp card but understand exceptions happen. To process interim reimbursement we need: 1) personal card statement showing the posted charge, 2) the POS/reservation receipt from the rental company, 3) manager approval (Priya confirmed), and 4) GL allocation. Use GLs: 6505-TRANSPORT-ENG (60%), 6506-TRANSPORT-SALES (40%). Mark note "interim - awaiting toll invoice" in Concur.
Finance Bot: Policy reminder: vehicle rentals > $500 require an itemized vendor invoice with tax registration for VAT reclaim. If tolls are billed later by a third-party to the rental company, finance will accept interim reimbursement and then reconcile when the vendor sends the toll invoice. Any VAT on tolls will be handled per vendor documentation.
Jason M: Ill include the list of passengers in Concur and attach the uploaded docs. I do need funds before my statement posts in 3 days  can AP expedite?
AP Team Bot: Expedited reimbursements are available for card-decline exceptions with manager approval. To trigger expedite: 1) mark `expedite` in Concur notes, 2) CC ap@redwood.com, 3) attach the docs Leo listed. Expect payout in 48 hours once AP confirms.
Priya S: Ive added a manager note approving expedite and the business purpose in Concur.
Leo K: Got it. Once toll invoice arrives, please forward vendor email or upload into the existing Concur item. We'll post any tolls as a separate adjustment and credit/charge back depending on reconciliation. If rental provides an adjusted invoice with VAT reg number, finance will attempt VAT reclaim and update ledger accordingly.
Jason M: Thanks all. Uploaded everything to Concur under "Ground Transport - Rental" and added `expedite`. Will ping here if rental emails the toll invoice.
Finance Bot: Reminder: if the rental never issues a separate toll invoice, AP will treat tolls as non-reclaimable and expense classification will remain gross. Finance will notify you if any additional docs are required for audit.
Jason M: Noted. Appreciate the quick turnaround :pray:
